subject: Coordination: renewal window, interim capacity top-up & staggered billing
messages:
From: Ben Howard <ben.h@acmecloud.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: 2027-04-25T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal request: capacity top-up & billing cadence options

Laura —

Quick note from procurement: our annual renewal is coming up 6/15 and we have a short mid-window need for an extra 200 GPU-months for a POC that will run in May. We'd like to: 
- Extend the private offer term to align with our fiscal year (through 2028-06-30)
- Add an interim top-up for May (200 GPU-months) that can be billed separately or as a staggered invoice before the annual PO hits in June

Can Redwood support a staggered billing arrangement (one invoice for the May top-up + main PO in June) and can you send a brief statement-of-work or PO spec we can run through our internal approvals? Our procurement contact is procurement@acmecloud.com — looping them here.

Thanks,
Ben Howard
Sr. Cloud Procurement
Acme Cloud Services

---
Attachments: acme_po_spec.xlsx (spec sheet, 24KB)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Ben Howard <ben.h@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-25T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request: capacity top-up & billing cadence options

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can do a staggered invoice for the interim top-up and align the private-offer term to your fiscal year. I’ve looped in Marissa (Marketplace / Commercial) and Rafael (Billing & Legal) to confirm the paperwork steps and timing.

Proposed next steps:
1) Redwood prepares a short addendum (redwood_private_offer_draft.pdf) that:
   - Adds a May interim top-up line item (200 GPU-months) billed net 30
   - Extends the commitment term to 2028-06-30
   - Notes a staggered billing cadence (top-up billed on acceptance, remainder invoiced at PO start)
2) Acme confirms whether the May top-up should be prepaid or invoiced (procurement preference)
3) Marissa to generate the marketplace private offer package + PO template for Acme to sign

I attached a draft and a spec sheet for your procurement team to review. If this looks good, can we aim to have signed paperwork by 2027-05-05 to lock capacity?

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

---
Attachments: redwood_private_offer_draft.pdf (3 pages), acme_po_spec.xlsx (spec sheet)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-26T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request: capacity top-up & billing cadence options

Ben / Laura —

Confirmed from the marketplace side: we can submit a Private Offer with two line items (interim top-up + main committed term). The typical flow we recommend is:
- Private Offer created and shared with Acme (DocuSign link included in the package)
- Acme returns signed PO for the interim top-up (we can mark it as an "activation" invoice)
- Marketplace billing will process staggered invoices per the dates on the PO

Attached a PO template we usually populate for Acme (po_template_acme.docx). Rafael — any constraints on changing the term end-date mid-contract that I should flag?

Marissa Cole
Senior Commercial Ops, Marketplace
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

---
Attachments: po_template_acme.docx

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Ben Howard <ben.h@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T10:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request: capacity top-up & billing cadence options

Looping in legal/billing notes —

We can support the term extension to 2028-06-30 and the interim top-up, but two items to call out:
1) When we add the May top-up as a separate invoice, we need Acme to confirm whether it will be treated as a one-time prepay or a standard invoice (prepay reduces the chance of allocation disputes). Please confirm the procurement preference.
2) For the marketplace private offer, the marketplace will require the private-offer acceptance window to be within 30 days of issue. If you need a longer acceptance window, we’ll need to embed language in the PO and coordinate with the marketplace account team.

I drafted a short clause to include in the addendum regarding staggered invoices — happy to redline the PDF and push the DocuSign envelope once Ben confirms billing preference.

Rafael Mendes
Head of Billing & Contracts
Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

---
Attachment: redwood_private_offer_draft.pdf (redline-ready)

From: Ben Howard <ben.h@acmecloud.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-27T07:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request: capacity top-up & billing cadence options

Thanks everyone — that all looks good. Procurement prefers to invoice the May top-up (no prepay), and we can sign the private offer once the DocuSign envelope is ready. We’ll need the PO to reference our internal charge code: ACME-SRE-Q2-PO.

Target: paperwork fully executed by 2027-05-05. I’ve CC’d procurement@acmecloud.com — they’ll push the internal approval once they see the DocuSign.

Best,
Ben
